traits.name: Ancient Architect
traits.description: The Altered One gains an advantage on Crafting tests.

traits.name: Self-Purity
traits.description: Once per round, the Altered One can end the effects of poison on themself (no action required).

actions.name: Exhale Toxins
actions.description: Attack +10, reach 10 ft., one target. Graze: 11 (2d10) vital damage. Hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) vital damage, and the target is Disoriented until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Tactical Insight
actions.description: Costs 1 Focus. The Altered One makes a DC 18 Deduction test. On a success, they grant the Focused condition to one ally they can influence within 30 feet of them until the end of that ally's next turn.

actions.name: Surge of Transformation
actions.description: Costs 2 Investiture. The Altered One chooses a Huge (15-foot) or smaller area or object within 30 feet of them that isn't being worn or held, transforming that area or object's essence into another. For example, they might transform empty air into stone or a wooden door into water. Depending on the nature of the transformation, this can cause an effect such as dealing damage to characters in that area or making them Restrained. Each character in that area must make a DC 16 Agility or Athletics test. On a failure, a character takes 22 (4d10) damage of a type appropriate to the essence (such as vital for poison or energy for fire), or they otherwise suffer an effect that fits the transformation. On a success, a character only takes 11 (2d10) damage if the effect can deal damage, or they otherwise suffer no effect.

actions.name: Regenerate
actions.description: Costs 1 Investiture. The Altered One recovers 6 (1d6 + 3) health. They can use this free action even while Unconscious or otherwise prevented from using actions.

actions.name: Demolish Weapon
actions.description: After the Altered One is hit or grazed by a non-Invested weapon, they can turn that weapon to smoke.

strikes.name: Knife
strikes.on-hit: the Altered One can spend 1 focus to deal an extra 5 (2d4) damage.
strikes.description: Attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 2 (1d4) keen damage. Hit: 9 (1d4 + 7) keen damage, and the Altered One can spend 1 focus to deal an extra 5 (2d4) damage.
